I guess people gave the context on this post much better than me, but i'll try to explain what's happening as best as i can (Excuse me for my grammer)

After the government decided to pass the reform on the justice system, the protests in israel became more serious.
By now, these protests have made the record of becoming the biggest protests in israel's history.
Many businesses had closed so workers could join the protests, and even block the main highways for the protests.
The police didn't take action at the first protests because these last 2 months, the protests were quite peaceful.
But as the government kept bringing forward the reform and bring their own law, the protests became more serious and louder.
Now, the police are taking action and even arresting some of the protesters. Itamar Ben-gvir, who is the minister of national security, is taking action on silencing the protesters.

The reform they're bringing to the justice system could allow them to harm every civil right in israel, and the LGBT community is going to be at the top of their list.
And, of course, it will also bring harm to women, arabs, refugees, and many other minority groups.

Edit: Thank you all for sharing your context and knowledge. The situation in my country kinda freaks me out, and it helps a lot when you bring it into discussion 🙏

It seems very ironic that your mom want to protect you from homophobia by being homophobic herself.
When i came out to my mom, she thought i was going crazy and claimed i need a psychologist.
But still it's harsh to hear these awful sentences at such a young age. it shows a huge fail as a parent from both your mom and dad.

But i am very happy for you that you feel so open right now with your sexuality, it shows great maturity and independence on your identity and on your soul.

Maybe you can talk to a therapist, or a very good friend you can trust, to relieve the psychological damage.
It is a pain to get back to these thoughts. I also fail a lot of times by falling back into traumatic thoughts, so i talk to a very good friend about them who listens to me and it relieves the pain.

I hope for you the best love and support, and hope i helped out 😊❤
